foundation_model_immutability.module_4_gradient_updates_to_ecg_fm: STRICTLY PROHIBITED (Zero gradient updates permitted to ECG-FM)

1_continuous_latent_representation.name: Z_ECG
1_continuous_latent_representation.description: Standardized continuous ECG representation pooled directly from the 12th Transformer encoder block of frozen ECG-FM.

2_structured_clinical_observations.name: O_l
2_structured_clinical_observations.observability_invariant: Masked leads are STRICTLY EXCLUDED from reported leads in st_elevation, st_depression, and t_wave_inversion.

4_lead_provenance_metadata.name: lead_provenance
4_lead_provenance_metadata.evidence_grounding_rule: Derived leads (III, aVR, aVL, aVF) cannot be counted as independent physiological evidence if parent leads (I, II) are masked or already counted.

5_candidate_disease_space.name: candidate_diseases
5_candidate_disease_space.invariance_rule: Identical 8 candidate classes evaluated in both Control Path and CKP Path.

6_evidence_schema.name: evidence_schema
6_evidence_schema.rule: Missing evidence must be marked UNAVAILABLE, never merged with CONTRADICTED or termed hallucination.

7_clinical_knowledge_pathway.name: ckp_evidence
7_clinical_knowledge_pathway.control_path_presence: NONE (Control path reasoning operates strictly on Z_ECG + O_l without external knowledge graph embeddings)
7_clinical_knowledge_pathway.format: Relational entity-relation triples grounded to SNOMED-CT / ICD-10 diagnostic criteria
